<div class='command-title'>Commands to convert data from one type to another.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> into {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |

You must use one of the following subcommands. Using this command as-is will only produce this help message.
